We present an effective method of exact solution of the (1+1)-dimensional Dirac equation with a linear scalar-like potential in the context of the generalized uncertainty principle (GUP). We employ the property of the harmonic oscillator that the kinetic energy part of the Hamiltonian is of equal weight to the potential energy part to obtain the energy levels from the deformation of the Dirac equation with a scalar-like linear potential through the generalized Heisenberg algebra of a GUP. Our result fully coincides with the results found in the literature.
